name: Akrion Technologies
old_description: Our legacy of over 30 years in the semiconductor industry is built on delivering cutting-edge wet process technologies that drive your success. Discover how our expertise can transform your operations.
about:
Akrion Technologies is based in Allentown, Pennsylvania, and has spent over 30 years developing wet process equipment for the semiconductor industry. The company was established to provide customized wafer surface preparation solutions, though the exact founding year and original founders are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs and builds automated wet stations for cleaning and stripping wafers ranging from 100 mm to 300 mm in diameter. Its product lines include the GAMA fully automated wet station, the PINNACLE SERIES cassetteless wet stations, and the V3 compact wet station, each handling batch sizes of 25 or 50 wafers. Akrion also supplies CVD, etch, furnace, and off‑line process tools, and reports more than 300 systems delivered to over 100 customers across five global locations.

Akrion serves the microelectronics sector, targeting analog IC, digital IC, power IC, MEMS, and R&D markets. Its equipment processes substrates such as silicon, silicon carbide, glass, and sapphire, supporting both bare and patterned wafers in production and research environments.

The company emphasizes customizable modular platforms, 24‑hour phone support for emergency service, and disciplined process management that it says reduces installation times and delivers high product reliability. Full technical support — including installation, maintenance, process assistance, training, parts repair, and system upgrades — rounds out its offering.
